content.summary: On Tuesday, Janover Inc (NASDAQ:JNVR) announced the purchase of 80,567 Solana (CRYPTO: SOL), valued at approximately $10.5 million. This purchase marks the third execution under its newly adopted digital asset treasury strategy. This purchase brings Janover's total Solana holdings to 163,651.7, valued at approximately $21.2 million inclusive of staking rewards.
